title: Oracle Apps Dba Consultant
description:
Key Skills: Oracle Apps DBA, Oracle EBS, Oracle RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, Shell Scripting, Concurrent Manager JD: Manage, administer, patch and upgrade Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and underlying databases. Perform Oracle EBS system cloning, database backup and recovery activities. Manage RMAN and Data Guard for backup and disaster recovery requirements. Administer Oracle RAC, ASM and concurrent managers in production environments. Perform database performance tuning, troubleshooting and issue resolution. Provide production support and ensure availability of Oracle EBS/database environments.

Key Skills: Data Guard,Shell Scripting,Concurrent Manager,Oracle Apps DBA,Oracle RAC,ASM,Oracle EBS,RMAN
